messages:
nate: Quick sync 9am PT - CloudCo wants to list a container + AMI across AWS/GCP/Azure. Main asks: publisher identity verification, trial SKU config, and a tiny CI helper to push new builds. Who owns the publisher identity steps?

olivia: I can own publisher identity (AWS) and the SAML link for Azure. Need someone for GCP service account and KMS access.

sam: I'll do GCP. Quick note: GCP marketplace requires signed images and a signed listing package. Also need the publisher org ID.

maya (CloudCo): We'll provide publisher admin email and a pointer to our KMS key. Prefer a 7-day trial. Also curious if you support single-tenant AMIs or only general public listings.

nate: We support both but AMI sharing flows differ per cloud; we'll document. Action list: (1) Olivia: AWS publisher verification steps + SAML doc, (2) Sam: GCP service account roles + sample terraform to grant roles, (3) Nate: small CI uploader examples (one-liners) for each cloud, (4) Maya: publisher admin + KMS pointer + EULA choice.

partners-bot: onboarding ticket created -> https://redwood.internal/marketplace/tickets/1761239876 (status: triage)

olivia: I'll add a short checklist to the ticket with required cert thumbprint format and expected manifest.json fields.

sam: tagging infra team for KMS cross-project grant.

maya (CloudCo): Thanks all, we'll aim to get the admin email + EULA selection today.
